name: St Mary and All Saints Church

layers.essential_history: [[c:Edward III began the church here, with a college for priests on its south side. The part that survives was started in 1434. Look up at the weathervane: a falcon, the badge of the House of York. Richard, 3rd Duke of York, and his wife Cecily Neville are buried inside.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The church has a 15th-century painted pulpit given by Edward IV. Each year the Richard III Society places white roses here on his birthday.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Inside, the candles have been knocked over. A trail of drips leads out of the south door.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The candle count]]
material: [[c:JOAN: "I set out twenty candles. Eight are still burning, nine are on the floor."]]
puzzle.question: [[c:How many candles are missing?]]
hints: [[c:Twenty take away eight, take away nine.]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:Three candles are missing. Someone took them to light their way in the dark.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:Three candles were taken to light someone's way.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:The college site is just south of the church.]]
